rationale: The released v1.83.1 already paints a physical 5 cm marker but picks only 12 CSS px, allowing a click inside the marker to move the wall body at high zoom. Aligns mouse ownership without changing geometry or writer safety.

summary.ru: Перетаскивание и правый клик работают по всей видимой площади узла стены при увеличении масштаба.
summary.en: Dragging and context menus work across the complete painted wall-node marker at high zoom.
